sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Abhishek Srivastava,Ashish Pandey,Avanish Kumar Srivastava
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
1. Heard Sri Anand Kumar Singh learned counsel for the applicant; Sri Abhishek Srivastava, learned
counsel for the informant and learned Aga for the State and perused the material placed on record.
2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, Sanjay Kumar Patel with a
prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 19 of 2024, under Sections 364, 376 (3), 302, 201
Ipc and Section 5L/5Q/6 Pocso Act, Police Station Kupsethi, District- Varanasi, during pendency
Sanjay Kumar Patel vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 June, 2025

entities.text: Sanjay Kumar Patel vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3.  There are allegations in the missing report dated 21.02.2024 given by the informant at police station that his daughter, Km. Monika Pal, born on 03.08.2008, left her house on 19.02.2024 at 11:00 A.M. but thereafter, whereabouts are not known.
Subsequently the applicant was arrested and in his statement recorded under section 164 of Cr.P.C.
he admitted that he had consenting relationship with the deceased since 03.09.2023.
The deceased had become pregnant and was threatening him for disclosing the fact of her relationship with him, hence on 19.01.2024 he throttled her to death in the coaching.
Thereafter he packed her dead body in a gunny bag and loaded it on the train.
5. In view of the above admission of the applicant in the statement before the Magistrate, it is not a fit case for grant of bail to the applicant at this stage.
6. The bail application is, accordingly, rejected.

Order Date :- 6.6.2025 Ruchi Agrahari / Manoj  Sanjay Kumar Patel vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 6 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174499248/
